title: Parking Violations (2007 - 2022)
description: This is a very large dataset, approximately 1.5 million records. It takes a long time to load. If there is a particular part of the city you are trying to look at, we recommend that you zoom into that section to allow that part of the map to populate. For more recent violations, go to our current dataset: Parking Violations - 2023 - Present . Data Dictionary: Label Definition Definition Source ticket_number The number of this ticket. This is what is listed on the parking ticket that is received and is the number that tracks this ticket internally. Parking Violations Bureau issued_date The date and time that this parking ticket was issued (MM/DD/YYY, HH:MM Format). Parking Violations Bureau location The block that this parking ticket was given. This is typically rounded to the 100 block number level. Parking Violations Bureau description The parking regulation that is alleged to have been violated. Parking Violations Bureau status The status of the payment for this parking violations. Can be either Paid in Full, Collections, Adjudication Approved, Promise to Pay, Adjudication Denied, Hearing Appeal Affirmed, Adjudication Partial, Paid in Collections, In Bankruptcy, or Administrative Review PIF. Parking Violations Bureau amount The amount (in dollars) of the fine that was charged. Parking Violations Bureau Dataset Contact Information: Organization: Parking Violations Bureau Position: Data Program Manager City: Syracuse, NY E-Mail Address: opendata@syr.gov
match_method: Official DCAT item ID and sublayer resolved through ArcGIS item metadata to the source URL.
